headline: ‘Dread Beat an Blood’ Set Black Londoners’ Struggle to a Groove
context: A newly restored 1979 documentary examines how Linton Kwesi Johnson’s dub-infused poetry documented the challenges faced by Britain’s Black Caribbean population.
